player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''TANTRUM''') posted a [[Light]] [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: A RST obj deck that doesnt blow up bunker, but still kicks @#$%
cards: Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Posted 4 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine. The draft had the side as Dark; the post is tagged Light and Rebel Strike Team is a Light objective.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(7)': Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed ('RST/GD'), Endor: Landing Platform ('EndorLanding Platfrom'), Endor, The Shield Is Down!, Heading For The Medical Frigate ('HFTMF'), Strike Planning and Squadron Assignments; these count toward the 60. The three Effects are the kind Heading For The Medical Frigate starts; none is named as the starting Effect, so none is singled out.
The objective's text deploys Endor and Rebel Landing Site, but the post lists 'EndorLanding Platfrom'; kept as posted (Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)).
Posted 'Squadron assignments' dested the Light Effect Squadron Assignments (the draft's Death Squadron Assignment is Dark); 'Endor' dested Endor (Light).
Posted 'Forest (NU)' (twice) and 'Desert(NU)' dested the Special Edition generic sites Forest and Desert.

Posted 'Blastech e11b' dested BlasTech E-11B Blaster Rifle; 'A280 Rifle' dested A280 Sharpshooter Rifle; 'Take the initiative' dested the Endor Interrupt Take The Initiative; 'Arcona' dested Arcona (the draft's Arica is a Dark character).

Posted 'Gen Madine' dested General Crix Madine; 'Beezer' Corporal Beezer; 'Corp Mildge' Corporal Midge; 'Lt Greeve'/'Lt Page' Lieutenant Greeve/Page; 'Endor Forest Trail' Endor: Hidden Forest Trail; 'Anakins stick' Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Battle Plan' the Light Endor Effect; 'YISYW' Your Insight Serves You Well; 'HOTJ' Honor Of The Jedi; 'SATM/BP' Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; 'Wedge RSL' Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Gen Calrissian' General Calrissian; 'DOS' Daughter Of Skywalker.
The strategy claims a 7-0 record with the deck; no tournament is named.
Later versions by the same author are DeckTech 16453 ('The Invincible Rebel Strike Team v 2 0') and 16469 ('v 3 0').
Total is 58 as published: the section headers add up to 60 (Characters(23), Effects and Interrupts(13)), but only 22 characters and 12 Effects/Interrupts are listed. Kept as posted.
